title: Jeremiah and the Broken Jar
description: The Lord sends Jeremiah to the Valley of Ben-Hinnom with a clay jar from the potter. Before the elders of the people and the priests, the prophet declares judgment on Jerusalem because they have worshiped Baal and sacrificed children. He breaks the jar as a sign that the city and its people will be broken beyond repair, and that their houses will become unclean like Topheth [ref:Jer 19:1-15|Jeremiah 19:1-15].
